text: How often have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless over the past 2 weeks?
How often have you had little interest or pleasure in doing things you usually enjoy?
How frequently do you feel emotionally drained, numb, or overwhelmed by routine feelings?
How often have you experienced sudden unprovoked shifts or drops in your mood?
How often do you feel burdened by feelings of worthlessness or excessive self-criticism?
How often do you find yourself feeling easily irritable, impatient, or frustrated?
How often have you felt nervous, anxious, on edge, or unable to sit still?
How frequently do you find it difficult to stop or control persistent worrying thoughts?
How often do you worry excessively about different things, even when there is no immediate reason?
How often do you experience a sense of dread, impending doom, or fear that something bad will happen?
How often do you experience physical anxiety symptoms (rapid heartbeat, shallow breathing, trembling)?
How often do you avoid social, academic, or professional situations due to anticipatory anxiety?
How often have you felt unable to relax, unwind, or let go of tension?
How frequently do you feel that pressures, deadlines, or responsibilities are piling up uncontrollably?
How often do you feel that you cannot cope with all the demands placed on you?
How often do minor unexpected changes or minor delays trigger disproportionate stress for you?
How often do you feel physical symptoms of stress, such as tight shoulder muscles, jaw clenching, or tension headaches?
How often do you find yourself reacting impulsively or snapping under pressure?
How often do you have trouble falling asleep within 30 minutes of getting into bed?
How often do you wake up repeatedly during the night or earlier than intended and struggle to fall back asleep?
How often do you wake up feeling unrefreshed, fatigued, or low on physical energy?
How irregular has your daily sleep and wake schedule been over the past two weeks?
How often does daytime drowsiness interfere with your focus or daily activities?
How often do you spend more than 30 minutes looking at screens in bed before sleeping?
How often do you find it hard to concentrate on reading, studying, or focused work?
How frequently do you experience racing, scattered, or disorganized thoughts?
How often do you experience brain fog, forgetfulness, or trouble remembering simple daily tasks?
How often do you struggle with indecision or putting off making even routine decisions?
How often do you feel that your mental processing speed or clarity has noticeably declined?
How often do you find yourself spacing out or losing track of conversations?
How often do you tend to isolate yourself or withdraw from family, friends, and peers?
How frequently do you feel lonely, unsupported, or misunderstood even around others?
How often do emotional challenges disrupt your ability to complete daily routines (hygiene, meals, chores)?
How often has your academic or work productivity declined due to how you have been feeling?
How often do you lack the motivation or willpower to begin tasks you know need to be done?
How often do you feel uncomfortable reaching out to someone you trust when feeling low or stressed?
